summary:
Implemented the next Garage Counter Mode slice.

Added `Skip This Item` and `Reset Skips` to the sticky iPhone Counter Mode panel. Skipping moves the current need-to-buy item behind the other current items for that Counter Mode visit only, without changing Need/Staged data, Garage Notes, backup/sync data, or vehicle facts. Search now finds skip-counter queries, and the service worker cache is bumped to `ridgeline-console-v305`.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v305-counter-skip -SkipScreenshots`
- iPhone-width screenshot: `debug-screenshots/audit-v305-counter-skip-mobile-garage.png`

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Garage Counter Mode now lets the user skip an unavailable parts-counter item and reset skips from the sticky iPhone panel.
Impact Reason: This makes the real store-run workflow more forgiving without falsely marking an item staged or adding new storage/schema.
